_comment: Hand-written Minecraft trivia for Merl's quiz (mod). The right answer is listed first; Merl shuffles the answers.

questions.q: How many hearts of health does a creeper have?
questions.why: Creepers have 20 health points, which is 10 hearts.

questions.q: What do you feed a turtle to breed it?
questions.why: Turtles breed with seagrass and lay their eggs on the beach they hatched on.

questions.q: Which mob drops a nautilus shell when it holds one?
questions.why: Drowned can spawn holding a nautilus shell in their off hand, and they always drop it.

questions.q: What item do you use to tame a wolf?
questions.why: Feeding a wolf bones has a chance to tame it.

questions.q: What does a cat bring you as a morning gift?
questions.right: Things like string, feathers or rabbit hide
questions.why: Tamed cats sleeping on your bed can leave a gift such as string, feathers, rabbit feet or phantom membranes.

questions.q: Which mob is scared of cats and ocelots?
questions.why: Creepers run away from cats and ocelots.

questions.q: What do skeletons run away from?
questions.why: Skeletons flee from wolves, which hunt them.

questions.q: How do you get a charged creeper?
wrong: Light it with flint and steel
questions.why: A lightning bolt near a creeper turns it into a charged creeper.

questions.q: What does a charged creeper's explosion make some mobs drop?
questions.why: Mobs killed by a charged creeper explosion drop their head, like a zombie or skeleton skull.

questions.q: Which mob can pick up and carry blocks?
questions.why: Endermen pick up certain blocks like grass, dirt, sand and flowers.

questions.q: What happens when you look an enderman in the eyes?
wrong: It gives you an ender pearl
questions.why: Looking at an enderman's upper body makes it hostile. A carved pumpkin on your head prevents this.

questions.q: What does a mooshroom give you when you use a bowl on it?
questions.why: Using a bowl on a mooshroom gives mushroom stew; a brown mooshroom fed a flower gives suspicious stew.

questions.q: How do you turn a red mooshroom into a brown one?
questions.why: A lightning bolt switches a mooshroom between red and brown.

questions.q: What do you get when you shear a mooshroom?
questions.why: Shearing a mooshroom drops five mushrooms and turns it into a cow.

questions.q: Which of these mobs is undead, so Smite hurts it more?
questions.why: Smite does extra damage to undead mobs, and wither skeletons are undead.

questions.q: Which enchantment does extra damage to spiders?
questions.why: Bane of Arthropods hurts spiders, cave spiders, bees, silverfish and endermites more.

questions.q: What do piglins love?
questions.why: Piglins admire gold and barter with gold ingots.

questions.q: What protects you from piglins attacking you on sight?
questions.right: Wearing a piece of gold armor
questions.why: Piglins leave you alone if you wear at least one piece of golden armor.

questions.q: What do you trade with piglins?
questions.why: Throwing a gold ingot to a piglin starts a barter.

questions.q: Which mob turns into a zombified piglin when struck by lightning?
questions.why: A pig struck by lightning becomes a zombified piglin.

questions.q: What does a villager turn into when struck by lightning?
questions.why: Lightning turns villagers into witches.

questions.q: How do you cure a zombie villager?
questions.right: Weakness potion, then a golden apple
questions.why: Throw a splash potion of weakness and give it a golden apple; it cures after a few minutes.

questions.q: What do iron golems sometimes give to villager children?
questions.why: Iron golems sometimes hold out a poppy, a nod to the film Castle in the Sky.

questions.q: How do you build an iron golem?
questions.right: Four iron blocks in a T and a carved pumpkin
wrong: Two iron blocks and a pumpkin
Four iron blocks and a skull
Iron ingots and a jack o'lantern on a fence
questions.why: Four blocks of iron in a T shape topped with a carved pumpkin or jack o'lantern.

questions.q: What do you need to build a snow golem?
questions.right: Two snow blocks and a carved pumpkin
questions.why: Stack two snow blocks and put a carved pumpkin on top.

questions.q: What happens to snow golems in hot biomes?
questions.why: Snow golems take damage in warm biomes like deserts and the Nether.

questions.q: How do you summon the Wither?
questions.right: Four soul sand or soil and three wither skeleton skulls
wrong: Nether bricks and a nether star
questions.why: A T of soul sand or soul soil topped with three wither skeleton skulls.

questions.q: What does the Wither drop?
questions.why: The Wither drops a nether star, used to craft a beacon.

questions.q: What do you need to respawn the Ender Dragon?
questions.why: Place four end crystals on the edges of the exit portal.

questions.q: What blocks heal the Ender Dragon?
questions.why: The crystals on top of the obsidian pillars heal the dragon.

questions.q: Which mob drops the elytra?
questions.right: None, you find it in end ships
questions.why: Elytra hang in item frames inside end ships near end cities.

questions.q: What do phantoms drop?
questions.why: Phantom membranes repair elytra and brew potions of slow falling.

questions.q: When do phantoms appear?
questions.right: When you haven't slept for three or more days
questions.why: Phantoms spawn at night over players who haven't slept for at least three in-game days.

questions.q: Which mob shoots fireballs in the Nether?
questions.why: Ghasts shoot explosive fireballs that you can hit back.

questions.q: What do blazes drop?
questions.why: Blazes drop blaze rods, needed for brewing stands and eyes of ender.

questions.q: What do magma cubes drop?
questions.why: Small magma cubes drop magma cream, used for fire resistance potions.

questions.q: Which Nether mob can you ride across lava?
questions.why: Saddle a strider and steer it with a warped fungus on a stick.

questions.q: What do you use to steer a pig you're riding?
questions.why: A carrot on a stick lets you control a saddled pig.

questions.q: What scares hoglins away?
questions.why: Hoglins avoid warped fungus, nether portals and respawn anchors.

questions.q: What happens to a piglin brought into the Overworld?
questions.right: It turns into a zombified piglin
questions.why: Piglins and hoglins zombify after 15 seconds outside the Nether.

questions.q: What item makes a llama carry chests?
questions.why: Put a chest on a tamed llama to carry items. Carpets decorate them.

questions.q: Which animal can you breed with hay bales?
questions.why: Hay bales heal horses and llamas, and breed llamas.

questions.q: What do you feed axolotls?
questions.why: Axolotls are fed and bred with buckets of tropical fish.

questions.q: Which axolotl color is the rarest?
questions.why: Blue axolotls have a 1 in 1200 chance when bred.

questions.q: What do frogs eat?
questions.why: Frogs eat small slimes, which drop slimeballs, and small magma cubes, which drop froglights.

questions.q: What decides a froglight's color?
questions.right: Which frog eats the magma cube
wrong: The biome of the magma cube
questions.why: Temperate, warm and cold frogs make different froglights.

questions.q: What do you need to tame a parrot?
questions.why: Feed a parrot seeds. Never feed them cookies; that kills them.

questions.q: Which food is poisonous to parrots?
questions.why: Cookies kill parrots, a nod to chocolate being toxic to real parrots.

questions.q: What do parrots do near a playing jukebox?
questions.why: Parrots dance when a nearby jukebox plays.

questions.q: What does a sniffer dig up?
questions.why: Sniffers dig up torchflower seeds and pitcher pods.

questions.q: Where do you find sniffer eggs?
questions.right: In suspicious sand in warm ocean ruins
questions.why: Brushing suspicious sand in warm ocean ruins can reveal a sniffer egg.

questions.q: What do armadillos drop when brushed?
questions.why: Brushing an armadillo drops a scute, used for wolf armor.

questions.q: What is made from armadillo scutes?
questions.why: Six armadillo scutes craft wolf armor.

questions.q: What does the warden use to find you?
questions.why: The warden is blind; it tracks vibrations and sniffs out players.

questions.q: What summons the warden?
questions.right: A sculk shrieker going off four times
wrong: Opening a chest in an ancient city
questions.why: Sculk shriekers summon the warden after the warning level reaches its limit.

questions.q: Which block hides your vibrations from sculk sensors?
questions.why: Wool blocks and carpets block vibrations.

questions.q: Where did the creeper come from?
questions.right: A coding mistake on a pig model
questions.why: Notch swapped the length and height values when making a pig, giving the creeper's tall shape.

questions.q: What does a shulker do when it hits you?
questions.why: Shulker bullets give you levitation.

questions.q: What do shulkers drop?
questions.why: Two shulker shells and a chest craft a shulker box.

questions.q: What do guardians protect?
questions.why: Guardians and elder guardians live in ocean monuments.

questions.q: What effect do elder guardians give you?
questions.why: Elder guardians give Mining Fatigue III to stop you breaking into the monument.

questions.q: What do you get from a breeze?
questions.why: Breezes in trial chambers drop breeze rods, used for the mace and wind charges.

questions.q: Where do breezes spawn?
questions.why: Breezes appear from trial spawners in trial chambers.

questions.q: Which mob is the bogged?
questions.right: A mossy skeleton that shoots poison arrows
questions.why: The bogged lives in swamps and trial chambers and shoots arrows of poison.

questions.q: What turns a skeleton into a stray?
questions.why: A skeleton stuck in powder snow turns into a stray.

questions.q: What happens when a zombie stands in water too long?
questions.why: Zombies drown and become drowned after about 30 seconds underwater.

questions.q: What do husks do differently from zombies?
questions.why: Husks live in deserts, don't burn, and give Hunger when they hit you.

questions.q: What does the creaking do when you look at it?
questions.why: The creaking only moves while nobody is looking at it.

questions.q: How do you defeat a creaking for good?
questions.why: Its creaking heart in a pale oak log keeps it alive.

questions.q: Which mob can carry two players at once?
questions.why: Camels can carry two players at once.

questions.q: Which animal can you ride and dash with?
questions.why: Camels can dash forward, and they're tall enough that most zombies can't reach you.

questions.q: What do you feed a camel to breed it?
questions.why: Camels love cactus.

questions.q: What does a goat drop when it rams a block?
questions.why: Goats ramming stone, logs, ore, packed ice or copper ore can drop a goat horn.

questions.q: What does a fox do with items?
questions.right: Picks them up and carries them in its mouth
questions.why: Foxes carry one item in their mouth, and sometimes spawn with emeralds or eggs.

questions.q: How do you get a fox to trust you?
questions.why: Baby foxes from bred wild parents trust you.

questions.q: What does a panda's personality depend on?
questions.why: Pandas have main and hidden genes: lazy, worried, playful, aggressive, weak, brown and normal.

questions.q: Which panda color is rare?
questions.why: Brown pandas have a recessive gene and are rare.

questions.q: What do bees need to make honey?
questions.why: Bees collect pollen from flowers and fill their hive.

questions.q: How do you collect honey without angering bees?
questions.why: Smoke from a campfire under the hive or nest calms the bees.

questions.q: What happens to a bee after it stings you?
questions.right: It loses its stinger and dies later
questions.why: Bees die shortly after stinging, like real honeybees.

questions.q: What does a glow squid drop?
questions.why: Glow ink sacs make sign text glow and craft glow item frames.

questions.q: Which tool do you use to get wool from a sheep without killing it?
questions.why: Shears give one to three wool, and the wool grows back when the sheep eats grass.

questions.q: Which sheep color is the rarest in the wild?
questions.why: Pink sheep spawn about 0.16% of the time.

questions.q: What happens when you name a sheep jeb_?
questions.right: Its wool cycles through rainbow colors
questions.why: A name tag with jeb_ makes the sheep rainbow. It still drops its original color.

questions.q: What happens when you name a mob Dinnerbone?
questions.why: Dinnerbone or Grumm flip mobs upside down.

questions.q: What happens when you name a rabbit Toast?
questions.right: It gets a special black and white skin
questions.why: Toast was a player's lost pet rabbit, added in memory.

questions.q: What rare rabbit attacks players?
questions.why: The Killer Bunny is a reference to Monty Python and only appears through commands.

questions.q: What happens when you name a vindicator Johnny?
questions.why: Johnny is a reference to The Shining.

questions.q: Which illager summons vexes?
questions.why: Evokers summon vexes and evoker fangs.

questions.q: What does an evoker drop?
questions.why: Evokers always drop a totem of undying.

questions.q: What gives you the Bad Omen effect?
questions.why: Ominous bottles give Bad Omen, which turns into a raid or trial omen.

questions.q: What do raids reward the hero with?
questions.right: Hero of the Village (villagers give discounts)
questions.why: Defeating a raid gives Hero of the Village and cheaper trades.

questions.q: Which mob rides a ravager in raids?
questions.why: Ravagers can carry a pillager, vindicator or evoker in later waves.

questions.q: What do witches throw?
questions.why: Witches throw harmful potions and drink helpful ones.

questions.q: What do wandering traders come with?
questions.why: Wandering traders bring two trader llamas on leads.

questions.q: What does the allay do?
questions.right: Collects items like the one you give it
questions.why: Give an allay an item and it gathers matching items for you.

questions.q: What makes allays duplicate?
questions.right: Giving one an amethyst shard while it dances
wrong: Two allays near a note block
questions.why: An allay dancing to a jukebox duplicates when given an amethyst shard.

questions.q: Which mob was chosen in the 2020 Mob Vote?
questions.why: Glow squids won the 2020 vote, beating the iceologer and moobloom.

questions.q: Which mob won the 2023 Mob Vote?
questions.why: The armadillo beat the crab and the penguin.

questions.q: Which mob won the 2022 Mob Vote?
questions.why: The sniffer beat the rascal and the tuff golem.

questions.q: Which mob won the 2021 Mob Vote?
questions.why: The allay won against the glare and the copper golem.

questions.q: What does a dolphin give you if you swim with it?
questions.why: Swimming near dolphins gives Dolphin's Grace.

questions.q: What do dolphins lead you to when fed raw fish?
questions.why: Feed a dolphin raw cod or salmon and it swims to the nearest shipwreck, ruin or buried treasure.

questions.q: Which mob drops prismarine shards?
questions.why: Guardians drop prismarine shards and sometimes crystals.

questions.q: What happens when you eat a pufferfish?
questions.why: Pufferfish give Poison II, Hunger III and Nausea.

questions.q: What do polar bears do when you get near their cubs?
questions.why: Adult polar bears turn hostile near their cubs.

questions.q: Which mob can climb walls?
questions.why: Spiders and cave spiders climb walls.

questions.q: When are spiders hostile?
questions.why: Spiders are neutral in bright light, unless you hit them.

questions.q: What does a cave spider bite give you?
questions.why: Cave spiders poison you on Normal and Hard difficulty.

questions.q: What do silverfish hide in?
questions.why: Silverfish hide in infested stone, cobblestone and bricks, often in strongholds.

questions.q: Where do slimes spawn in the Overworld?
questions.why: Slimes spawn deep in slime chunks and at night in swamps.

questions.q: What moon phase makes the most slimes spawn in swamps?
questions.why: Swamp slimes spawn most on full moons and never on new moons.

questions.q: What tool do you need to mine obsidian?
questions.why: Only diamond or netherite pickaxes break obsidian and drop it.

questions.q: What is the weakest pickaxe that can mine diamond ore?
questions.why: Diamond, gold, emerald and redstone ore need an iron pickaxe or better.

questions.q: What do you get when lava flows onto water?
questions.right: Stone or obsidian, depending on which flows
questions.why: Water on a lava source makes obsidian; lava flowing into water makes stone or cobblestone.

questions.q: What makes basalt form naturally?
questions.right: Lava over soul soil next to blue ice
questions.why: A basalt generator needs lava flowing over soul soil beside blue ice.

questions.q: What does a sponge do?
questions.why: Sponges soak up water and dry in a furnace or the Nether.

questions.q: Where do you find sponges?
questions.why: Elder guardians drop wet sponges, and monuments have sponge rooms.

questions.q: Which of these blocks survives a TNT explosion?
questions.why: Obsidian (and crying obsidian, the anvil and ancient debris) survive explosions easily.

questions.q: How many blocks of obsidian does a smallest nether portal frame need?
questions.why: A 4 by 5 frame needs 14, but 10 is enough when you skip the corners.

questions.q: What lights a nether portal?
questions.right: Fire, like flint and steel or a fire charge
questions.why: Any fire inside the frame lights it, including a fire charge.

questions.q: What is crying obsidian used for?
questions.why: Six crying obsidian and three glowstone craft a respawn anchor.

questions.q: What charges a respawn anchor?
questions.why: Each glowstone block adds one charge.

questions.q: What happens when you use a bed in the Nether?
questions.why: Beds explode in the Nether and the End.

questions.q: Which block makes a beacon beam change color?
questions.why: Stained glass or panes above a beacon tint the beam.

questions.q: How many layers can a beacon pyramid have?
questions.why: A full pyramid has four layers and uses 164 mineral blocks.

questions.q: Which blocks can a beacon pyramid be made of?
questions.right: Iron, gold, emerald, diamond or netherite blocks
questions.why: Any mix of those five mineral blocks works.

questions.q: What does a conduit need around it?
questions.right: Prismarine, sea lanterns and similar blocks
questions.why: Conduits need a frame of prismarine, dark prismarine, prismarine bricks or sea lanterns.

questions.q: What is the conduit made of?
questions.right: A heart of the sea and nautilus shells
questions.why: A heart of the sea surrounded by eight nautilus shells.

questions.q: Where do you find a heart of the sea?
questions.why: Buried treasure chests always have one.

questions.q: Which block is the hardest to break by hand of these?
questions.why: Obsidian takes 250 seconds by hand.

questions.q: Which block can't be broken in Survival?
questions.why: Bedrock is unbreakable. Reinforced deepslate can't be mined in Survival either, but bedrock is the classic answer.

questions.q: What does a note block's sound depend on?
questions.why: Wood gives bass, sand gives snare drums, gold gives bells, and so on.

questions.q: What sound does a note block on a gold block make?
questions.why: Gold blocks under a note block play the bell (glockenspiel).

questions.q: What does a jukebox play?
questions.why: Jukeboxes play music discs and give a redstone signal.

questions.q: Which music disc is made from fragments?
questions.why: Nine disc fragments from ancient cities craft Disc 5.

questions.q: Where do you find the Pigstep disc?
questions.why: Pigstep is only found in bastion chests.

questions.q: How do you get a music disc from a creeper?
questions.right: Let a skeleton's arrow kill it
wrong: Let it explode near a jukebox
questions.why: Creepers killed by skeleton arrows drop one of several music discs.

questions.q: What does a composter make?
questions.why: Filling a composter with plant items makes bone meal.

questions.q: What do you get from smelting cactus?
questions.why: Cactus smelts into green dye.

questions.q: What do you get from smelting sand?
questions.why: Sand and red sand smelt into glass.

questions.q: How do you make concrete?
questions.right: Place concrete powder next to water
questions.why: Concrete powder hardens when it touches water.

questions.q: What do you smelt clay into?
questions.why: A clay block smelts into terracotta; a clay ball into a brick.

questions.q: What makes glazed terracotta?
questions.why: Any dyed terracotta smelts into its glazed version.

questions.q: What does a lodestone do?
questions.right: Makes a compass point to it
questions.why: Use a compass on a lodestone to link it.

questions.q: What does a recovery compass point to?
questions.why: Echo shards and a compass craft a recovery compass.

questions.q: Where do you find echo shards?
questions.why: Echo shards are found in ancient city chests.

questions.q: What does a spyglass do?
questions.why: Spyglasses are made of amethyst and copper.

questions.q: What grows on budding amethyst?
questions.why: Amethyst buds grow on budding amethyst into clusters, which drop shards.

questions.q: Can you move budding amethyst with Silk Touch?
questions.why: Budding amethyst drops nothing, even with Silk Touch.

questions.q: What does tinted glass do?
questions.right: Blocks light but lets you see through
questions.why: Tinted glass is see-through but blocks light.

questions.q: What does a daylight detector do at night when inverted?
questions.why: Right-click a daylight detector to invert it into a night sensor.

questions.q: What does an observer do?
questions.right: Sends a pulse when the block in front changes
questions.why: Observers detect block updates.

questions.q: What does a comparator measure from a chest?
questions.why: Comparators give a signal strength based on container fullness.

questions.q: How far does a redstone signal travel through dust?
questions.why: Redstone dust loses one strength per block, from 15 to 0.

questions.q: What is a redstone repeater used for?
questions.why: Repeaters reset the signal to 15 and can delay it up to four ticks.

questions.q: Which of these blocks can't be moved by a piston?
questions.why: Obsidian, bedrock and some other blocks can't be moved by pistons.

questions.q: What does a slime block do with pistons?
questions.right: Moves the blocks stuck to it
questions.why: Slime and honey blocks drag neighboring blocks along.

questions.q: What's special about honey blocks?
questions.right: They slow you down and reduce fall damage
questions.why: Honey blocks are sticky: slow movement and less fall damage.

questions.q: Which of these cancels fall damage completely when you land in it?
questions.why: Landing in water stops fall damage. Hay bales reduce it by 80%.

questions.q: Which of these also cancels fall damage?
questions.why: Cobwebs, powder snow, sweet berry bushes, vines, ladders and scaffolding also cancel it.

questions.q: What does scaffolding let you do?
questions.right: Climb up and drop down quickly
questions.why: Scaffolding is made of bamboo and string.

questions.q: What's made from bamboo and string?
questions.why: Six bamboo and a string craft six scaffolding.

questions.q: What crop can you only grow on soul sand?
questions.why: Nether wart grows only on soul sand.

questions.q: What does chorus fruit do when eaten?
questions.why: Eating chorus fruit teleports you up to 8 blocks.

questions.q: What do you smelt chorus fruit into?
questions.why: Popped chorus fruit crafts purpur blocks and end rods.

questions.q: Which food gives you the most saturation?
questions.why: Golden carrots give 14.4 saturation, more than any other common food.

questions.q: What does eating a golden apple give you?
questions.why: Golden apples give Regeneration II and Absorption.

questions.q: How many slices does a cake have?
questions.why: A cake has seven slices.

questions.q: What does honey do to poison?
questions.why: Drinking honey cures poison without removing other effects.

questions.q: What does milk do?
questions.why: Drinking milk clears every effect, good and bad.

questions.q: What is suspicious stew made with?
questions.right: Mushrooms, a bowl and a flower
questions.why: The flower decides which effect the stew gives.

questions.q: Which item is used to brew almost every potion first?
questions.why: Nether wart turns water bottles into awkward potions.

questions.q: What does adding redstone to a potion do?
questions.why: Redstone extends the duration; glowstone makes it stronger.

questions.q: What turns a potion into a splash potion?
questions.why: Gunpowder makes splash potions; dragon's breath then makes lingering ones.

questions.q: What does a fermented spider eye do in brewing?
questions.why: It turns Speed into Slowness, Healing into Harming, and so on.

questions.q: What fuels a brewing stand?
questions.why: One blaze powder fuels 20 brews.

questions.q: What does a potion of the turtle master give?
questions.why: Brewed with a turtle shell.

questions.q: What is the max level of an enchanting table?
questions.why: An enchanting table with 15 bookshelves offers level 30.

questions.q: How many bookshelves does a max enchanting table need?
questions.why: Fifteen bookshelves, one block away from the table.

questions.q: Which enchantment lets you walk on water by freezing it?
questions.why: Frost Walker turns water under you into frosted ice.

questions.q: Which enchantment repairs items with experience?
questions.why: Mending uses experience orbs to repair the item.

questions.q: Can Mending and Infinity go on the same bow?
questions.why: Mending and Infinity are mutually exclusive.

questions.q: Which enchantment gives more drops from ores?
questions.why: Fortune increases drops from ores like diamonds and coal.

questions.q: Which enchantment makes mobs drop more loot?
questions.why: Looting works on swords.

questions.q: Which enchantment lets a trident pull you through the air in rain?
questions.why: Riptide launches you when it's raining or you're in water.

questions.q: Which trident enchantment summons lightning?
questions.why: Channeling strikes lightning during thunderstorms.

questions.q: Which mace enchantment makes you float up after a hit?
questions.why: Wind Burst launches you upward after a smash attack.

questions.q: What is the mace made of?
questions.right: A heavy core and a breeze rod
questions.why: Heavy cores come from ominous vaults.

questions.q: Which curse makes an item disappear when you die?
questions.why: Items with Curse of Vanishing vanish on death.

questions.q: What's needed to upgrade diamond gear to netherite?
questions.right: A netherite upgrade smithing template and an ingot
questions.why: Use a smithing table with the template, the diamond item and a netherite ingot.

questions.q: How many netherite scraps make a netherite ingot?
questions.why: Four scraps and four gold ingots craft one ingot.

questions.q: What do you smelt ancient debris into?
questions.why: Ancient debris smelts into netherite scrap.

questions.q: At what height is ancient debris most common?
questions.why: Ancient debris is most common around Y 15 in the Nether.

questions.q: At what height are diamonds most common?
questions.why: Since 1.18, diamonds are most common near the bottom of the world.

questions.q: Which ore only generates in mountain biomes?
questions.why: Emerald ore only generates in mountain biomes.

questions.q: Which biome has extra gold ore near the surface?
questions.why: Badlands generate extra gold ore up to Y 256.

questions.q: What does nether gold ore drop?
questions.why: Nether gold ore drops 2 to 6 gold nuggets.

questions.q: What is raw copper smelted into?
questions.why: Raw copper smelts into copper ingots.

questions.q: What stops copper from oxidizing?
questions.why: Honeycomb waxes copper so it stays the same.

questions.q: How do you remove oxidation from copper?
questions.why: Axes scrape off one stage of oxidation, and lightning removes it too.

questions.q: What does a lightning rod do?
questions.why: Lightning rods protect flammable builds and give a signal when struck.

questions.q: What is a totem of undying used for?
questions.why: Held in either hand, it saves you from a lethal hit.

questions.q: Which item lets you breathe longer underwater as a helmet?
questions.why: Turtle shells give 10 seconds of Water Breathing when you go underwater.

questions.q: What does a trial key open?
questions.why: Trial keys from trial spawners unlock vaults in trial chambers.

questions.q: What do you need for an ominous vault?
wrong: A trial key and an emerald
questions.why: Ominous trial spawners drop ominous trial keys.

questions.q: What does a brush do?
questions.right: Uncovers items from suspicious sand and gravel
questions.why: Brushes are for archaeology and for armadillo scutes.

questions.q: What are pottery sherds used for?
questions.why: Four sherds or bricks craft a decorated pot.

questions.q: What can you add to armor at a smithing table for decoration?
questions.why: Armor trim templates plus a material add patterns.
